verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity and fraud decisioning SaaS, so a natural-language command interface is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented way to operate the product with natural-language commands. The marketing line about "agentic automation" describes automated KYC/AML checks, not user-issued natural-language commands. The llms.txt docs index and OpenAPI file are only machine-readable building blocks, which earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
